delivered_artifacts.artifact_class: Workflow Control-Flow Compiler & Deterministic Scheduling Engine

gate_1_deterministic_routing.description: Same workflow IR + same execution state snapshot produces bit-for-bit identical RoutingDecision digest.

gate_2_loop_bound_enforcement.description: Loop execution stops deterministically at max_iterations with TERMINATE_LOOP action without exceeding host bounds.

gate_3_join_synchronization.description: JOIN nodes synchronize predecessor branches according to policy (ALL, ANY, QUORUM) and wait until conditions are met.

gate_4_timeout_transition.description: Elapsed duration exceeding timeout_seconds is detected on running nodes and flagged for recovery routing.

gate_5_human_gate_suspension.description: HUMAN_GATE steps remain suspended in waiting_human_gates until an explicit, signed grant from COMMANDER lane is registered.
